findings.title: Terminal-restore panic hook does not itself check scoped_credential_callback_active; suppression relies on chaining into the vault-aware hook
findings.failure_path: set_panic_hook is installed after install_panic_hook (lib.rs:1423 -> tui.rs:420) and chains to the vault-aware hook without checking the thread-local flag first; formatting is suppressed only because the inner hook checks. A future edit that formats panic_info before chaining could leak a secret-bearing payload.
findings.recommendation: Add the scoped_credential_callback_active() early-return inside set_panic_hook before any formatting, or pin the check-before-format invariant with a comment and test.
findings.regression_test: Subprocess test installing an additional hook after the vault hook, panicking with a canary secret inside a scoped callback, asserting the canary is absent from stderr/logs.

findings.title: Fail-closed 1 MiB capture ceiling yields an undifferentiated 'exceeds the capture limit' error for large secret-free transcripts
findings.failure_path: With bounded_output removed, any probe stream over 1 MiB hard-fails qualification; the error does not report measured bytes, so a noisy secret-free transcript is indistinguishable in message from a true overflow-denial.
findings.recommendation: Include the measured byte count in the QualificationError message so operators can distinguish 'secret found' from 'transcript too large'; behavior itself (fail closed) is correct.
findings.regression_test: Existing test_run_command_capture_limit_is_utf8_bytes_and_fails_closed covers the boundary; extend to assert the message includes the byte count if added.
